blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A woman was wounded after two unidentified motorcycle-riding gunmen fired several shots at her vehicle along Chino Roces Avenue in Makati on Thursday morning. In a report by the District Tactical Operations Center of the Southern Police District, the shooting occurred at about 6:50 a.m. along Chino Roces Avenue in front of Unibank and BDO, beside Oriental Place in Barangay Pio del Pilar. Authorities are conducting further investigation and case buildup to identify the suspects and circumstances behind the shooting.
